name: @nuclo/native-ts
description: POC: nuclo apps compiled ahead of time from TypeScript to Swift (UIKit) and Kotlin (Android Views). No JavaScript engine ships with the app.

scripts.check:android: for app in test/fixtures/accept.ts examples/full-showcase/App.ts examples/bench/App.ts; do tsx src/compiler/cli.ts build $app --out build/check/$(basename $(dirname $app)) && (cd hosts/android && ./gradlew compileDebugKotlin --offline -q -PnucloSources=../../../build/check/$(basename $(dirname $app))/android) || exit 1; done
scripts.android: bun run build:showcase && cd hosts/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --offline
